name: StartPlaylist

parameters.help_en: The ID of the playlist. If you add items to the playlist by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848078.html operation, use the value of the ProgramId parameter that is returned
parameters.help_zh: 节目单ID。如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848078.html添加节目单项，请查看AddPlaylistItems接口调用返回的参数ProgramId值
parameters.name: program_id

parameters.help_en:
The restart mode. Valid values:

- **Restart**: Starts from the beginning.

- **Continue**: Resumes playback from where it was stopped. The **StartItemId** parameter is required only when you set the **ResumeMode** parameter to **Custom**.

- **Custom**: Custom start point
parameters.help_zh:
重启模式。取值：
- **Restart**：从头开始。
- **Continue**：根据停止前播放位置继续。如果**ResumeMode**参数设置为**Custom**时，请求参数**StartItemId**才必填。
- **Custom**：自定义
parameters.name: resume_mode

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the item to play first. When the carousel starts, this item is played.

><notice>

This parameter is required only when you set **ResumeMode** to **Custom**.

></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
起始节目单项ID。启动轮播时将先播放此节目单项。
><notice> 如果**ResumeMode**参数设置为**Custom**时，此参数才必传。
></notice>
parameters.name: start_item_id

parameters.help_en:
The start offset for the video file. This parameter is valid only for video files. Unit: milliseconds.

A value greater than 0 specifies the start time relative to the first frame
parameters.help_zh:
启动偏移。视频文件起始偏移值。仅对文件视频有效， 单位：毫秒。

大于0，表示从相对于首帧的偏差时间作为开始读取的位置
parameters.name: offset
